component.name: ButterEye
component.summary: Smoother motion for the videos you play in mpv

description.p: ButterEye interpolates video to a frame rate that suits your display, live in mpv or as a saved copy, using RIFE on the GPU (Vulkan, or experimental NVIDIA TensorRT) or MVTools on the CPU. It works with your distribution's own mpv and never edits your mpv.conf.
Drop a video on the window to play it smooth, or on the second drop zone to save a smooth copy. A short speed test picks the best engine your computer can keep up with.
